name: Devouring Plague
summary: In Orgrimmar, Devouring Plague training begins with Ur'kyo sending Forsaken priests home. They have come to Kalimdor to learn from the Darkspear, but Aelthalyste waits in Undercity to teach them the shadow arts of their own people.

sections.title: An Exchange of Faiths
sections.body: Ur'kyo guides those drawn to spiritual power in Orgrimmar. Among the Horde, Darkspear trolls and Forsaken share a curious bond in matters of faith, while orcs and tauren show little inclination toward priestly worship. Ur'kyo knows Forsaken initiates must master the shadow arts tied to their own condition. In respect between their peoples, he sends wandering Forsaken back to Lordaeron to complete their training.

sections.title: The War Quarter of Undercity
sections.body: Beneath Lordaeron's ruins, Priestess Aelthalyste tends the flock in Undercity's War Quarter. Forsaken priests follow a solitary, grueling path shaped by their turn to shadow. They endure the painful touch of the Holy Light and learn to wield the devastating affliction of Shadow magic. When an initiate gains sufficient prowess, Aelthalyste gathers them close and teaches the affliction her kind calls Devouring Plague.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Ur'kyo, the troll priest trainer among the spirits in Orgrimmar, offers this to Forsaken priests who have reached their twentieth circle of power.

faq.q: Where do I need to go?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Travel across the Great Sea to Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. Seek Priestess Aelthalyste, who oversees Forsaken priest training in the War Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Ur'kyo send Forsaken back to Lordaeron?
aliases: why does troll priest send me away
faq.answer: Ur'kyo honors an understanding with Priestess Aelthalyste. Troll shadow priests understand loa and spirits, while Forsaken wield dark arts tied to their undead nature and need instruction from their own leaders.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Devouring Plague?
faq.answer: Devouring Plague is a potent affliction of the Shadow, learned by every priest at level twenty. It afflicts targets with devastating disease and siphons their life force back to the caster.

faq.q: Can other Horde races accept this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only Forsaken priests are offered this, as it represents their communion with their homeland's unique shadow disciplines.

faq.q: How does this fit into Horde priest relations?
faq.answer: The Horde shares training duties between Darkspear witch doctors and hex priests on Kalimdor and Forsaken shadow priests in the Eastern Kingdoms. Each people directs travelers to masters suited to their culture.

angles.text: As a priest, you draw on the Forsaken's doctrines of shadow and decay, channeling physical torment into dark rites such as Touch of Weakness and Dark Sacrifice.
As Forsaken, returning to the War Quarter in Undercity recalls that your allegiance and spiritual roots lie beneath Lordaeron's ruins, wherever Horde duties take you.
As Horde, you share training duties between Ur'kyo in Durotar and Aelthalyste in Tirisfal, a sign of cooperation and mutual respect between the distant capitals.
